Dialogs.Dialog: Come on, it's obvious at this point, right？
I can't help it... I just want to right now.
Even I have moments like this, you know.
Hey, come a little closer... okay？
Come on, it's fine. We're a couple.
Are you just clueless？ Or is this on purpose？
Was now... not a good time？
Close enough to make my heart race.
This means... what I think it means, right？
Don't be in such a rush.
You don't have to pull that hard, you know.
Hehe, it's nice when you're forceful once in a while.
I'm not going to run away, you know.
To be honest, I really wanted to make up with you sooner.
I always love you, no matter what.
Look at that! ...Oh, never mind, I must've imagined it.
I'll get mad if you aren't gentle with me, okay？
Can I let you spoil me？
You know, I... No, never mind.
I think I might pass out...
It feels like I'm in a dream.
I didn't know... you could feel like this.
More than embarrassed... I'm just happy.
We're in our own little world, aren't we？
I don't want anyone getting in our way...
I'm keeping you all to myself forever!
I wish time would just stop...
Tell me you love me more.
I'm not going to say no...
That spot feels all funny now.
Not gonna do it？ Oh, fine...
Are we in kissing mode now？
No need to be so forceful...
Honestly... what am I gonna do with you.
Sure, I don't mind at all.
Are you even thinking about how I feel？
What is it？ Let me hear more.
All my focus goes straight to my ears.
Don't keep me waiting too long, okay？
You're going to... kiss me, right？
Should I just... wait like this？
I wonder if I'll do it right？
I'm falling for you more and more...
Maybe this is what they call... lovey-dovey.
I bet it's only this good because it's you.
It's just between the two of us.
Mm... That surprised me a little.
Geez... Are you trying to tease me？
Hehe... Know what I want to do？
Hey... Think we got a little closer？
Do you love me even more now？
I think... I love you even more now.
Hehe... That was a little mean of me.
There are other places, aren't there？
I want a different kind of kiss.
How about a change of pace？
Ah... I let my guard down.
Come on... that's still not enough.
Big mistake if you think we're done♪
Don't stop... Kiss me some more？
I want to keep kissing like this forever...
You know, I really like... your lips.
How long are you gonna keep going？
Are you okay after kissing this much？ Because I'm...
My senses... are starting to go crazy.
I love you most of all...
Could I get any happier than this？
Just saying I love you isn't enough...
We really do love each other, huh.
I just love you way too much.
I only have eyes for you...
I can't imagine anything better than this...
Phew... Am I allowed to be this happy？
I can't live without you anymore, you know.
Making me fall for you this hard... You'd better take responsibility, okay？
I'm already thinking about our next kiss...
I really do love you, okay.
Let's stay crazy about each other forever.
Can't you tell by looking at me？ I'm happy.
You really like kissing, don't you...
Wait, is kissing all you can think about？
I feel a lot better now♪
Next time, let's do more... No, never mind.
I'm not some kissing fiend, you know.
How about an even hotter kiss next time？ Hehe.
I knew it, I really do love you...
How can I stay mad when you kiss me like that...
I forgot what I was even worried about. Hehe.
Geez... I mean, it's fine, but...
It's not like... I hated it, though.
Sigh... Getting satisfied with something like this...
That was so sudden... It's fine, though...
It might be a problem if you're always like this, though.
Jeez, my face is so hot...
Just because I don't say no...
Think about what you did, seriously.
